turns.prompt_text: How can I view the photos in this zip? Attached 1 file.
turns.response_html: The attached zip contains too many files to process. For more information, see here.

The file you uploaded, T152.ithmb, is not a standard image file like a JPEG or PNG. Instead, it is an iPod and iPhone Photo Thumbnails File. These files are proprietary to Apple and are used to store multiple thumbnail versions of images to make photo browsing faster on iOS devices.

Because they contain a collection of small, uncompressed thumbnail data rather than a single standard image, you cannot view them by simply double-clicking them in a standard photo viewer.

To view or extract the photos from this file, you can use the following methods:

Recommended Software for Viewing

  • For Windows:
    • iThmb Converter: A widely used tool specifically designed to view and convert these files into standard formats like JPEG, PNG, or BMP.
    • Ithmb Viewer: Available on the Microsoft Store, this app allows you to browse images within the file and convert them to JPG.
    • Ultra File Opener: A general-purpose file viewer that supports the .ithmb format.
  • For Mac:
    • File Juicer: A utility that can extract images from various file types, including .ithmb, and convert them to TIFF or JPEG.
    • GraphicConverter: A powerful image processing tool that can open and read proprietary Apple thumbnail formats.
    • Keith's iPod Photo Reader: A free, legacy tool for reading .ithmb files, though it is primarily compatible with older versions of macOS (Mojave or earlier).

Online Conversion Options

If you prefer not to install software, you can use online conversion services like Zamzar, CoolUtils, or CloudConvert. You simply upload the .ithmb file, and they will attempt to convert the contents into a downloadable format like JPEG.

Note: Since these are thumbnail files, the resulting images may be lower resolution than the original full-sized photos.
